'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****Three [[commercial vessel]]s are reported to be attacked near the [[Strait of Hormuz]], including the [[Qatar]]i [[Liquefied natural gas|LNG]] [[LNG carrier|tanker]] ''Al Rekayyat'', which is owned by [[Nakilat]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-us-israel-war-oil-4732228810c9839a1258309ad43b8289 (AP)]
****''Al Rekayyat'' is reported to be at a risk of explosion following the attack. The attack marks the first time a vessel from Qatar was attacked since the war started on February 28. [https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/07/lng-tanker-risk-exploding-after-vessels-struck-near-strait-hormuz (Al-Monitor)]
****The [[United States]] revokes the temporary [[United States sanctions against Iran|sanctions]] waiver against [[Iran]]ian [[Petroleum industry in Iran|oil]] issued as part of the [[Islamabad Memorandum]] after the attacks on the three vessels. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/us-revokes-iran-oil-waiver-after-hormuz-tanker-attacks-6239421 (AFP via CNA)] [https://www.axios.com/2026/07/07/us-revokes-iran-oil-waivers-hormuz-strait-attacks (''Axios'')]
****[[U.S. forces]] strike [[List of equipment of the Islamic Republic of Iran Air Defense Force|Iranian air-defence]], [[Mass surveillance in Iran|coastal surveillance]], and [[Ballistic missile program of Iran|missile]] sites after attacks hit three commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, with explosions heard in [[Bandar Abbas]], [[Bandar Sirik]], and [[Qeshm Island]]. Iran accuses the U.S. of violating their memorandum of understanding and warns of retaliation. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/us-iran-strike-hormuz-tanker-attacks-6239441 (AFP via CNA)]

Macron was not at the hotel during the explosions. [https://apnews.com/article/syria-france-macron-damascus-explosions-4bbe664b13bc1fb18042e9689f4ceab7 (AP)]
